name: The Hidden Niche
summary: Alaric's memories lead you back into Fenris Keep. His remains point toward a forgotten alcove where he seeks rest and an old relic waits.

sections.title: A Restless Request
sections.body: Alaric remembers Fenris Keep in its better days. Horde scouts have lifted his bones from a shallow grave outside the stronghold, but he will not go quietly to the Sepulcher. He offers vital knowledge instead: a hidden niche in the keep's southwestern tower holds an item treasured by Thule Ravenclaw and his fellow mages.

sections.title: Buried in the Walls
sections.body: You carry Alaric's remains through Fenris Keep, past the Rot Hide gnolls that infest the island fortress. In the upper levels, a dusty bookshelf hides the compartment he described. Alaric asks to be sealed inside the keep's ancient masonry, where he spent the happiest days of his life, beyond the gnolls' reach.

faq.answer: Alaric served Thule Ravenclaw as head servant and bodyguard at Fenris Keep. Thule beheaded him after creating the Rot Hide gnolls. Found in a shallow grave outside the fortress, Alaric's animated spirit guides Horde travelers in exchange for a proper resting place inside his beloved stronghold.

faq.q: Where is the hidden niche located?
faq.answer: The hidden niche lies behind a dusty bookshelf on an upper floor of Fenris Keep's southwestern tower.

faq.q: What item is hidden in the alcove?
faq.answer: The alcove holds an old wand treasured by Thule Ravenclaw and his former peers from Dalaran, along with other remnants Alaric leaves for those who helped him.

faq.q: Why does Alaric want to stay inside Fenris Keep?
faq.answer: Alaric remembers his years in Fenris Keep as the happiest of his life. Resting inside its stonework brings him peace and protects his remains from the scavenger gnolls in the courtyards.

faq.q: What happens after finding the shelf?
aliases: what do i do with the wand
faq.answer: After Alaric is sealed in the niche and you retrieve the wand, you return to the Undercity to deliver it to Bethor Iceshard.

faq.q: Why did Alaric tell you to leave his boots behind?
faq.answer: When his bones were lifted from the shallow grave, Alaric joked that his old boots never fit properly and insisted they stay in the dirt.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, you know the business of speaking remains, but Alaric's wish for rest in human ruins recalls the lands your people inherited.
The hidden alcove preserves Fenris Keep's arcane heritage, with artifacts tied to former Dalaran wizards such as Thule Ravenclaw.
As Horde, you recover relics from the heart of Fenris Keep, weakening Thule's foothold on Fenris Isle and aiding the Forsaken campaign to secure Silverpine Forest.
